method_notes.loading: AST-load unmodified queue and Dijkstra definitions; replace factory with documented counting adapters and controls.
method_notes.oracle: independent heapq implementation, exact full distance-map equality; same edge-key-0 length semantics as original city-mode Dijkstra.
method_notes.training_cost: Charge ONE baseline Dijkstra plus predictor construction. Original getKeyPredictions redundantly invokes getRanks before its collecting run; that extra run is not charged here. training_run elapsed times are instrumented and must not be used as deployed training cost.
method_notes.binary_heap_original_metric: Original countComps adds logarithmic expressions based on heap size; it is a proxy, not measured heapq comparisons. queue_order_comparisons uses wrapped keys to count actual heapq ordering operations.
method_notes.accounted_order_comparisons: Lower-bound subtotal: measured queue clean order comparisons + exact-advisor ordering + auxiliary SortedList ordering. Excludes linear/hist predictor boundary checks, arithmetic, sentinel checks, dictionary/equality work and runtime overhead; not a total operation count.
method_notes.rank_bucket_items_visited: Visited elements in original rankVal[rank].remove(value), counted with a semantics-preserving list subclass; reported separately from ordering comparisons.
method_notes.value_rank_items_visited: Visited elements in valRank[value].remove(rank), separately counted.
method_notes.identity: Artifact numeric control predictedRank=key. It moves exact ordering into SortedList; it is NOT the theorem bounded-integer-universe model and needs no training.
method_notes.sortedlist_direct: Control uses SortedList directly as a priority queue; needs no training.
method_notes.histograms: Equiwidth CDF with interpolation; B bins, O(1) lookup, trained from same key trace. low/high clamps apply; no held-out target fitting.
method_notes.source_groups: One train source, disjoint near/far deciles (or larger for tiny graphs), and remaining uniform reachable held-out sources; randomized source and method execution order.
method_notes.timing: Counted runs include instrumentation and are unsuitable for performance claims. Optional timing runs omit comparison wrappers and scan counting; original artifact queue counters/tracking remain. Host uncontrolled.
method_notes.scope: Frozen graph, one train source, limited query sources and queue seeds. All failures retained; no upstream algorithm patch.

released_artifact_not_figure_replication: Shipped Brussels GraphML has 2268 nodes and4393 raw arcs (4378 key-0 arcs); paper appendix figure labels Brussels1380 nodes/2580 edges. Cause unverified.
